subject: The 3AM mistake that set me back 2 weeks
preview_text: I almost gave up. Then my AI therapist showed me the easy fix that changed everything.
body_paragraphs: Three weeks into my breakup, I was lying awake at 3AM, scrolling through her Instagram for the 47th time. I thought I was healing. Actually, I was feeding the wound. That mistake cost me two weeks of progress—and I see it happen to almost every user who downloads Fresh Start.

The #1 mistake most people make? They try to heal alone, in their head, at their worst moments. They replay conversations, stalk the ex, and convince themselves it means something. It doesn't. You're just giving your brain a cheap dopamine hit that keeps you stuck. The fix is simple: don't trust your 3AM brain. Let something else carry the weight.

That's why we built Emergency Mode. When you're spiraling—like I was—open the app and tap the red button. It gives you a 2-minute grounding exercise designed to shut down the obsessive loop. It's not therapy. It's a fire extinguisher. And it's saved my sanity more times than I can count.

Open Fresh Start: Breakup Therapy tonight. If you feel that familiar pull toward your ex's profile, use Emergency Mode instead. P.S. One user told me it cut her late-night spirals from 5 hours to 20 minutes. That's not a typo.
